hardware.tested_state: firmware with active review inactivity timeout compiled, flashed, and protocol-smoked

procedure: Built the T-Display S3 firmware with ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh.
Confirmed the ESP-IDF build reported app version 3df0d69.

expected_result: The firmware that includes a five-minute RAM-only active-review inactivity timeout still builds, flashes, and preserves the disabled signing protocol contract.

The protocol response for sign_event remains signing_disabled.
No persistent key custody, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, enclosure, or production approval policy was validated.
